Go down into the depths of {wiki:Cyclopolis}, north of Edron, cross five floors of cyclopes, fire elementals and dragons, and clear a final room with 4 {creature:Behemoth|Behemoths}. Inside you will find a {item:Demon Shield}, a {item:Golden Armor}, a {item:Guardian Halberd}, a {item:Platinum Amulet}, a {item:Life Ring}, a {item:Crystal Ring} and gems.
Level 80 (there is a level 80 {item:Door of Expertise} before the final room, and another level 30 one along the way).
recommended: Cyclops Smiths can make you drunk
Optional: {item:Stealth Ring} or {spell:Invisible} to get past the cyclopes
With a {item:Stealth Ring} or {spell:Invisible} you can run past the cyclopes, but the {creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals} on the lower floors can see you anyway.
If your level is borderline, ask a higher-level player for help with the final room.
Go to **Edron** (by boat: at the captain in your city say {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}) and walk **north** of the city to {wiki:Cyclopolis}. Go in.
Go down to the **5th underground floor** (the dragons' one), following the maps below (one per floor). Along the way there is a level 30 {item:Door of Expertise}. Get ready for:
Map 4: red = level 30 Door of Expertise
Map 5: red = lever that removes the rocks (see section 3)

Lots of {creature:Cyclops|Cyclopes}, {creature:Cyclops Drone|Cyclops Drones}, {creature:Dwarf Soldier|Dwarf Soldiers}, {creature:Dwarf Guard|Dwarf Guards} and, sometimes, an {creature:Orc Leader}, {creature:Orc Berserker}, {creature:Minotaur Mage} or {creature:Elf Arcanist} lured by someone.
Lots of Cyclopes, Cyclops Drones, {creature:Cyclops Smith|Cyclops Smiths} and Dwarf Soldiers.
Lots of Cyclopes, Cyclops Drones, Cyclops Smiths and one {creature:Fire Elemental}.
Lots of Cyclopes, Cyclops Drones, Cyclops Smiths and {creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals}.
3 {creature:Dragon|Dragons}, 2 Fire Elementals and a {creature:Dragon Lord} (in the cavern).

Go down one more floor: you see the Behemoths' floor below. Head **north**, behind the stairs, and look for a spot to use {spell:Levitate} downwards (*exani hur down*) and drop to a small platform with 2 {creature:Cyclops|Cyclopes}.
Use Levitate here to go down to the platform below
On the platform, go to the **north** edge and look north for **big rocks**. If there are **no rocks**, skip section 3 and go straight to section 4.
If the rocks are there, you have to pull the lever
3. Pull the lever (only if there are rocks)
Go back **south** and use {spell:Levitate} upwards (*exani hur up*) to climb to the platform you came from.

Head **east** and go down the stairs. Go all the way **west** and halfway **south** to the next stairs. Go up, and follow either path to the **southeast** stairs. Go up and kill the {creature:Dragon Lord}.
Destroy the field and pull the lever
Use a {item:Destroy Field Rune} on the **westernmost** square of the row in the **north** corridor: the lever is there. You may need to move corpses to find it. Leave the lever pointing **right**.
Make sure the lever is pointing right
Make sure the lever points **right**, otherwise the rocks won't disappear.
Retrace your steps to the rocks area to continue.
Go down to the Behemoths' floor
Go down the stairs from the platform and kill the {creature:Behemoth|Behemoths}, {creature:Dwarf Soldier|Dwarf Soldiers} and {creature:Cyclops|Cyclopes} that show up next to the stairs.
Head **north** through the narrow passage and go up the stairs. Pass the **level 80** {item:Door of Expertise} and get ready for the final room.

In the final room there are **4 {creature:Behemoth|Behemoths}, 2 {creature:Cyclops Smith|Cyclops Smiths} and 2 {creature:Dragon|Dragons}**. Possible strategies:
- **Druids:** magic shield and *stair hop* (going up and down the stairs) with {spell:Eternal Winter} and {spell:Avalanche} or {item:Sudden Death Rune|Sudden Death Runes}.
- **Sorcerers:** the same, but with {spell:Rage of the Skies}.
- **Knights:** {spell:Berserk} or {spell:Fierce Berserk}.
- **Paladins:** {spell:Divine Caldera}, but killing them one by one with {item:Energy Wall Rune|Energy Wall Runes} is probably more efficient.
Behemoths hit very hard. Use a {item:Dwarven Ring}: Cyclops Smiths can make you drunk.
With the room cleared, go to the **north** end of the room: the rewards are there.
Demon Shield, Golden Armor, Guardian Halberd, Platinum Amulet, Life Ring, Crystal Ring, 3 Small Diamonds and 4 Small Sapphires

Go back the same way: leave the final room through the level 80 door, go down the stairs and return through the narrow passage to the stairs of the small platform. Go up them and, at the **south** edge of the platform, use {spell:Levitate} upwards (*exani hur up*) to return to the platform you came from. From there climb the 5 floors of Cyclopolis following the maps in section 1 in reverse, up to the entrance **north of Edron**.
Without {spell:Levitate} (or parcels) you can't leave the small platform: save mana for it.
The required level changed from 60 to 80 at the end of 2004 or the start of 2005.
